summary: Doctoral training in human genetics and genomics, with strengths in molecular genetics, statistical genetics and genetic epidemiology, and genetic counseling.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application deadline
deadlines.note: The School of Public Health explicitly labels its table Spring 2027 and Fall 2027; Human Genetics PhD is December 15.

english.note: Human Genetics departmental thresholds are higher than school-wide minimums. Exemptions are described on the international applicants page.

applicationFee.note: SOPHAS charges $155 for the first program and $65 for each additional program. Limited SOPHAS financial-, service-, and international-based fee waivers are offered; eligibility must be confirmed. Pitt secondary coupon codes exclude PhD programs.
